description: This file contains implementation of replication padding functions and their metadata definitions for the PyTorch library, including forward and backward functions for 1D, 2D, and 3D padding.

methods.name: replication_pad1d
methods.description: Meta function for 1D replication padding, sets output tensor shape based on input and padding size.

methods.name: replication_pad1d_backward
methods.description: Meta function for backward pass of 1D replication padding, checks output size consistency.

methods.name: replication_pad2d
methods.description: Meta function for 2D replication padding, sets output tensor shape based on input and padding size.

methods.name: replication_pad3d
methods.description: Meta function for 3D replication padding, sets output tensor shape based on input and padding size.
